text: The authors state their experiments are a controlled simulation of debate and consultancy and in-the-wild deployment may differ; that annotators are U.S.-based English speakers selected by belief and demographics; and that each high-stakes domain beyond COVID-19 and climate change needs its own empirical validation before deployment.
